The '''Taldot system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]]<ref name="O2" /> in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stronghold (planet)|Stronghold]].<ref name="O2" />
